extracted.intended_audience: researchers and community organizers interested in open collaborative preprint peer review (including early-career researchers and low-resource contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: Organizing and participating in open, collaborative peer review of preprints via a 'crowd' model where leads select papers, members asynchronously annotate, and leads synthesize a combined review posted publicly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of crowds (team-based review)
rubrics_metrics.description: Leverage teams of researchers called crowds to provide open, collaborative evaluation of research, using diverse perspectives and expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ASAPbio runs crowds with co-leads and many members; crowds allow reviewers to contribute without each doing a comprehensive review, and enable efficient, rich feedback through coordinated effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defined crowd roles (co-leads and members)
rubrics_metrics.description: Organize crowds with structured roles: co-leads (three co-leads in the program) who select papers and synthesize reviews, and crowd members who annotate and comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Co-leads select a preprint each month and synthesize contributions; members contribute asynchronously. Role clarity enables coordination and final unified outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preprint selection cadence
rubrics_metrics.description: Every month, crowd leads select a preprint for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monthly selection provides a predictable rhythm for crowd activity and planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeboxed contribution window
rubrics_metrics.description: Give crowd members a fixed, short window (two weeks) to asynchronously mark up the paper and provide comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A clear, time-limited period focuses participation, ensures momentum, and supports timely synthesis by leads.

rubrics_metrics.name: Synthesize contributions into a single combined review
rubrics_metrics.description: Crowd leads aggregate and synthesize individual comments into one combined review representing the crowd's assessment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leads produce a final synthesized review that is posted publicly; synthesis balances multiple voices into a coherent, actionable review for authors and readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post reviews publicly on PREreview.org
rubrics_metrics.description: Publish the final synthesized review on PREreview.org as part of PREreview Clubs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Posting publicly allows authors and the wider community to benefit; platform integration increases visibility and discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discoverability via partner indexing
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure reviews are integrated with partners (e.g., indexed by Sciety, displayed alongside preprints on servers like bioRxiv).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integration with partner services makes reviews easier for readers to discover and ties reviews to the preprint record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer credit and privacy options
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide opt-in crediting (linked to ORCID) and flexible identity options: named (ORCID-linked), pseudonymous, or fully anonymous reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allowing different identity preferences accommodates diverse needs and encourages participation; PREreview handles these options seamlessly so contributors can choose how their contributions are recorded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform usability and low-friction workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a user-friendly platform (PREreview) that enables quick upload of a review and easy attribution of contributing crowd members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A top-notch user experience means leads can upload a review and add contributors in minutes, lowering administrative overhead and encouraging participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive participation and training
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a structured reviewing experience and training so that people without prior reviewing experience (including early-career researchers and those in low-resource settings) can participate effectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training and structured workflows let contributors develop reviewing skills and ensure contributions are useful; previous reviewing experience is not necessary to join.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage diversity and strength-in-numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalize on diverse expertise and collective effort so that crowds can provide rich feedback efficiently without expecting every member to perform a full review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distributing tasks across members enables coverage of different expertise areas and produces more comprehensive feedback than individuals working alone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thematic/focus selection for crowds
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus each crowd on particular subject areas (e.g., Cell Biology, Meta-Research) to align reviewer expertise with selected preprints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Having thematic focus helps ensure reviewers have relevant domain knowledge and that the crowd’s feedback is targeted and high-quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measure and communicate program impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Track program outputs and participant feedback (e.g., number of papers reviewed, median reviewers per paper, participant-reported skill development) to evaluate effectiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ASAPbio reported 122 papers reviewed since 2021 and member feedback that they appreciated skill development and collaboration; such metrics support continual improvement and outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide resources and toolkits to start local crowds
rubrics_metrics.description: Make an easy toolkit and guidance available for people who want to start their own preprint review crowd or club.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical toolkits lower the barrier to launching new crowds and spread the model; community calls and documentation support organizers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer community events for onboarding and best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Host community calls and discussions (e.g., on how to start a crowd, benefits of collaborative review, and how to use the platform) to onboard members and share best practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regular community events provide synchronous opportunities to learn workflows, ask questions, and build community among reviewers.
